ModMetaData.name: Branding Ritual
ModMetaData.author: toasterbath
ModMetaData.description:
Adds an ideology-neutral ritual for marking a pawn with a permanent brand.
A moral guide gathers a piece of steel, carries the target onto the ritual spot or altar, and holds the iron beside them while you choose a mark. The target is held in place for the duration and cannot walk away.
Every ideology may perform the ritual: it requires no memes and no additional precepts, so it is always available.
Four brands are offered, each leaving a different permanent mark:
Brand of Service The bearer works faster, but holds them back in every conversation.
Brand of Chains The bearer is held fast and stays docile. Slave suppression lasts far longer and they rarely think of rebellion. They have little left to say for themselves.
Brand of Pain Feeling runs shallow beneath the mark. The bearer shrugs off what should floor them and rarely goes down from pain. Still, they have little left to say for themselves.
Brand of Pleasure The bearer draws others in and holds attention easily. Their focus wanders and work suffers for it.
The brands are permanent. Choose carefully.
Developed against RimWorld 1.6.4871.
